name: himawari
description: Himawari — a sunflower, a town, and another day. Both editions from one source.

scripts.test:logic: for c in en zh-CN; do node tests/mechanics.mjs $c && node tests/walkthrough.mjs $c && node tests/guide.mjs $c && node tests/journal.mjs $c && node tests/audio.mjs $c && node tests/audio-transitions.mjs $c && node tests/scenes.mjs $c && node tests/original-fixes.mjs $c || exit 1; done && node tests/localization.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:logic && node tests/loader.mjs && npm run test:ui && npm run test:assets
scripts.test:ui: python3 tools/build.py >/dev/null && node tests/ui.mjs en && node tests/ui.mjs zh-CN && node tests/notebook.mjs en && node tests/notebook.mjs zh-CN
scripts.test:assets: python3 tests/assets.py en && python3 tests/assets.py zh-CN
scripts.android:sync: python3 tools/build.py --app && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
